newsitem.title: USA: Senate panel to vote Wednesday on USDA nominees.
newsitem.headline: Senate panel to vote Wednesday on USDA nominees.

text.p: The Senate Agriculture Committee is expected to approve Clinton administration nominees to fill four top slots at the U.S. Agriculture Department when it votes on Wednesday.
"We're not anticipating any problems" with the nominations, a committee spokeswoman said.
The nominations include the promotion of Foreign Agriculture Service Administrator Gus Schumacher to the post of Undersecretary for Farm and Foreign Agricultural Services.
Catherine Wotecki, the current acting Undersecretary for Research, Education and Economics, would switch jobs and become Undersecretary for Food Safety.

The panel will also vote on the nominations of Shirley Watkins to be Undersecretary for Food and Consumer Services and Miley Gonzalez to take over as Undersecretary for Research, Education and Economics.
Watkins is currently a deputy assistant secretary for marketing and regulatory programs.
Gonzalez is an associate dean at New Mexico State University and the only nominee from outside the department.
The panel will vote on the nominations after it finishes work Wednesday on agricultural research legislation.
If all goes well, the Senate could approve the four nominees by the end of the week, when it is scheduled to leave for a month-long August recess.
"That is the hope," the committee spokeswoman said.
